blocks.text: Facts here come from the municipality, TransLink or BC Transit, the Ministry of Education and Child Care, and the retailers’ own pages, listed under Sources. Walking and driving times were measured on OpenStreetMap routing on November 2, 2026, from the point named under the table.

items.t: No rapid-transit station is in Delta. Nearest rapid-transit station: Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), reached by TransLink Route 601 from Ladner Exchange.
Nearest bus exchange: Ladner Exchange, served by Routes 601, 616, 617 and 618.
Route 618 Ladner North/Ladner Exchange (TransLink): loop from Ladner Exchange through this area via Central Ave, Westminster Ave, Ferry Rd, Admiral Way and Admiral Blvd.
Route 601 Bridgeport Station/South Delta (TransLink): from Ladner Exchange via Ladner Trunk Rd, Hwy 17A and Hwy 99 to Bridgeport Station.
Ladner Harbour Park, 4905 Mcneelys Way, Delta.
Ladner Leisure Centre, 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent, Delta.
Neilson Grove Elementary, K-7, School District 37 Delta, 5500 Admiral Blvd; catchment not confirmed.
Delta Secondary, 8-12, School District 37 Delta, 4615 51 St; catchment not confirmed.

items.t: Official boundary: the City of Delta publishes no boundary for the Neilsen Grove name.
Walk to Ladner Harbour Park: dropped — the routed distance (0.27 km) was shorter than the straight-line distance, so it was not plausible.

faq.a: The area is spelled "Neilsen Grove"; the school is spelled "Neilson Grove Elementary", at 5500 Admiral Blvd on its School District 37 school site and in the BC Ministry of Education K-12 schools file.
faq.q: How is the area name spelled, and how is the school name spelled?
